Subject: Redwood credits + onboarding options for Cobalt AI

Ethan —

Great to meet you on Friday. As discussed, Redwood offers a startup onboarding package we typically extend to early accelerator companies: an initial 30k token credit, onboarding support, and the option to request a promotional extension tied to demo milestones. To speed things up I attached a short SOW that outlines the onboarding scope and timing (Cobalt_Onboarding_SOW.pdf).

To confirm next steps from our side:
- We can provision an initial 30k token credit immediately upon account activation.
- If you can confirm demo date + a short product walkthrough, we can consider a 60-day trial extension and an additional promotional credit (see qualifications below).
- We’ll need a contact for SSO/SCIM setup, and any required PO or procurement information for later invoicing.

Qualification highlights (summary):
- Accelerator or cohort affiliation (simple confirmation email OK)
- Demo day slot or scheduled customer-facing milestone within 60 days
- Short technical onboarding call (30–45m) during week of May 22nd

If you’re aligned, I’ll loop in Ben (sales ops) and Laura (onboarding) to get an approval path started.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

—Jordan

Jordan —

Thanks, appreciate the recap and the SOW. Quick questions from our side:
1) What specific metrics or artifacts do you need to qualify for the promotional extension? We’re in an accelerator but the official confirmation takes a few days.
2) Would Redwood consider an initial larger trial (60k tokens) for demo prep? Our demo is June 28th and we’ll need to run a couple full flows.

Also — our engineering lead for integrations is Maya Patel (maya@cobalt.ai). She’ll own SSO/SCIM and the technical onboarding.

Can Ben/Laura outline the exact approval timeline? If we get the extension confirmed this week we can lock a couple prep sessions.

Thanks,

Ethan — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing Maya’s contact. Looping Ben and Laura so they see the ask.

Ben/Laura — quick summary: Cobalt is requesting (a) a larger initial trial (60k tokens) for demo prep, and (b) eligibility for a 60-day trial extension + promotional credit conditioned on the June 28th demo and a short public demo or recorded session. They’re in an accelerator but cohort confirmation may lag.

Proposed approval path (what I’ll submit to ops):
- Immediate: provision 30k token credit on account activation (standard).
- If Cobalt confirms demo date + provides accelerator affiliation (email or program landing page), we’ll bump the initial trial to 60k tokens and approve a conditional 60-day extension + 100k token promotional credit to be released after demo validation.
- Legal: standard MSA (no custom terms); we’ll use DocuSign for the signature.
- Finance: approval for credits subject to t&c and a one-time promo code.

Ethan — I’ve added links below for the HubSpot record and the DocuSign template we’ll use. Ben, can you confirm budget/manager sign-off timeline? Laura, can your team prepare onboarding slots for the week of May 22 and June 12 for deeper integration sessions?

HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/12345
DocuSign MSA template: https://www.docusign.com/transactions/0A1B2C3D4E

—Jordan

I reviewed the ask with sales ops and finance. We can support the 60k upfront trial increase and the conditional 100k promotional credit tied to the June 28 demo and the recorded demo requirement. I’ve attached the internal promo approval memo (promo-approval.pdf).

Notes:
- Finance needs a signed MSA before the promo code is applied; promo code will be valid for 90 days from issuance.
- If the cohort confirmation email is delayed beyond May 22, we can accept an accelerator landing page + program admin confirmation instead.

I’ll mark this as approved pending the signed MSA. Jordan — please proceed to send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
